messages:
Ava (PM): Quick sync — FinLedger asked for end-to-end visibility for their production workload. They want: per-model cost breakdown, an error analytics view that surfaces sample traces, and tracing hooks that tag model_id + route. Can we scope an MVP that we can commit to for Q2?
Ravi (Eng-ML): Thanks. We can do model_id span tagging + basic per-request cost attribution. Full per-token cost calc is heavier.
Maya (SRE): Two operational constraints: sampling must be low-overhead (<3% p99 overhead) and we need a canary rollout path. Also need redaction for PII in traces.
Tom (DevEx): UX ask — customer wants a single dashboard link to share with their infra team, plus CSV export for cost slices.
Ava (PM): Proposal: MVP = 1) Dashboard with 3 widgets (latency p50/p95, error rate by service, cost per-model aggregated daily) 2) Tracing hooks: span tag model_id + route + short error_code 3) Error analytics: grouped error classes with 10 sample traces each. Canary + privacy redaction required. Thoughts?
Ravi (Eng-ML): That seems reasonable. Implementation notes: tagging is ~1 day per runtime (we have 3 runtimes). Cost per-model needs a join between billing events and trace metadata — estimate 4-6 days.
Maya (SRE): Redaction rules: default redaction (headers, body), with opt-in deeper scrubbing for FinLedger. Canary window: 48h with live alerting to oncall if error rate delta > 2x.
Tom (DevEx): For the dashboard we can reuse the existing console widgets and a new slice filter for model_id. Should be ~2 frontend days if backend provides endpoints.
Ava (PM): Ok combine estimates: tagging 3 days, cost join 5 days, backend dashboard endpoints 3 days, frontend wiring 2 days, sampling/canary infra 2 days, tests/docs 2 days. Total ~17 dev-days. Can we cut scope to ship in 10?
Ravi (Eng-ML): Cut options: a) Ship tagging + dashboard with mocked cost (placeholder) and add accurate cost in follow-up. b) Reduce sample traces to 3 per error class. c) Limit runtime coverage to 1 runtime for canary.
Maya (SRE): I'd push for option (c) combined with (b). Real cost accuracy can come later. We must not ship without redaction or canary.
Ava (PM): Decision draft: MVP-lite for Q2 = tagging + dashboard widgets + model_id filter + sampling (3 traces per error class) + canary on single runtime + mocked cost tile (with note). Acceptance criteria in checklist below. If we hit the canary with no regression for 48h we flip to full rollout.
observability-bot: NOTE: linked ticket OBS-872 created for this work and auto-assigned to Eng-ML queue.
Ravi (Eng-ML): Works for me — will split into sub-tasks. Will need product to provide example FinLedger queries and the CSV export spec.
Tom (DevEx): I'll draft the dashboard mock and CSV schema today.
Maya (SRE): I'll add the canary runbook and the PII redaction checklist to the ticket.
Ava (PM): Acceptance checklist (to confirm before flip):
```
- span tags: model_id + route + error_code present in 100% of instrumented requests
- dashboard: latency, error rate, cost-tile (placeholder) + model_id filter
- error analytics: grouped errors + 3 sample traces per group
- canary: single runtime coverage, 48h window, alerting rule in place
- overhead: perf regression <= 3% p99, verified in lab
- redaction: headers/body PII stripped; FinLedger deeper scrub opt-in implemented
- docs: public console docs + runbook + customer handoff notes
```
Ava (PM): If no objections by EOD we'll lock scope and schedule for next sprint. :calendar: :thumbsup:
Ravi (Eng-ML): +1
Maya (SRE): +1
Tom (DevEx): +1
Ava (PM): Thanks team — I'll update the ticket with the scope and canary plan.
